messages:
Claudia: Hey folks — quick personal update: moved into a tiny SoMa studio last week and just got promoted to Senior PM today! :tada: Thinking a small in-office celebration next week? Nothing big, cake + plants.
Ravi: MASSIVE congrats!! :confetti_ball: When are you thinking?
Claudia: Thanks!! Wed 3pm or Thurs lunch — which is better?
Nia: Wed 3pm for me. I can bring cake (will bring a vegan option).
Jordan: Thurs lunch slightly better for my calendar but could make Wed if needed. I can pick up savories from the deli.
Mira: Ill bring a little succulent as a housewarming gift. Congrats!! :seedling:
Sam: Senior PM!! so proud :raised_hands: I vote Wed so we can do a toast before sprint planning.
Kala: Wed works. I'll grab Conf B for 3	3:45 and send an invite. Someone add a quick poll: cake vs cupcakes vs empanadas? :smile:
Claudia: Poll (emoji vote): :cake: cake, :cupcake: cupcakes, :taco: empanadas. Im not trying to be the promo boss who chooses empanadas for themselves 😂
Ravi: :cake:
Nia: :cupcake:
Jordan: :taco:
Mira: :cake: (honestly happy with anything)
Kala: party-bot: RSVP reminder please react by EOD Tuesday.
party-bot: Reminder set: "Claudia celebration" on 1718978400 (Wed 3pm) 5 responses so far.
Claudia: Love you all. Ill DM Kala about logistics. Also if anyone wants to swing by my new place for a tiny Sunday brunch later this month, open invite no pressure. :heart:
